newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Chittenden Corp Q2 net rises 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Chittenden Corp Q2 net rises 12 pct.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q2 net interest margin rose to 5.15 percent from 5.03% during the same period last year.
-- Credit card and net merchant processing income increased to $2.8 million in first half of 1997 from $961,000.

-- Mortgage servicing income declined slightly in the first half of 1997 compared with last year, as a result of increased amortization expense related to originated mortgage servicing rights. As a result of decreased market activity in 1997, year-to-date gains on sales of mortgages fell $300,000 in 1997 from $1.4 million during the same time last year.
